### Advent Meditation: The One Gift We Need
Author: Collin Hansen
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/advent-meditation-one-gift/
Passage: Psalm 16:11
Points:
- The path of life is not a map or hidden secret, but Jesus Himself.
- Walking with Christ is not about foreseeing future troubles, but trusting His guidance.
- Worldly pleasures and seasonal festivities inevitably fail to satisfy the heart.
- Christ secured our eternal joy in God's presence through His death and ascension.

### Knowing Whose You Are Changes Everything
Author: Tim Tebow
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-26-2016.html
Passage: Psalm 16:8
Points:
- Unexpected failures and broken dreams can easily shake a person's identity.
- Earthly markers like status, possessions, and achievements are fragile and temporary.
- True security comes from remembering who we belong to as children of God.
- Setting the Lord continually before us keeps us unshaken through every storm.
